CRT proves each rational density. No finite computation substitutes for the unbounded prime-gap lemma or density proof.

originality.rationale: The exact fourteen closed intervals with exact rational densities at r=3 are absent from the directly relevant published texts inspected. Sanna proves a general algorithm and gives an explicit three-component r=2 calculation, while Achenjang–Berger cite only a plotted lower bound C_3 >= 14. Our proved C_3 <= 14 and complete interval and probability table go beyond this. A general computability theorem is not itself an evaluation. Unindexed prior worked-out computations remain a real risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact r=3 computation may exist.
The Sanna general algorithm already covers symbolic computability, so novelty is the exact fixed-parameter resolution, not a new structure theorem.
The equality C_3=14 was anticipated as a plotted lower bound, so count alone is not a newly suggested phenomenon.
